feature: Persistent clipping highlights with source verification and union rendering

commands.command: cargo test -p femto-reader --test highlights --test clippings --test ui

checks: Shared detail-menu toggle enables and disables highlighting without moving the reading anchor
Host and journal reopen retain exact highlighted pixels
Font-size reflow and portrait/clockwise rotation keep source ranges and produce palette-preserving inversion
Repeated capture retains highlight and original timestamp
Overlapping saved highlights and pending selection invert shared pixels once
Invalid source cannot be enabled; malformed enabled excerpts are omitted with deduplicated warning and can be disabled
Exact-record state mutation rejects stale clipping
CLI journal export retains enabled highlight metadata and does not change source journal files

firmware.installation_status: No automatic installer. Verify the actual device partition table and recovery backup before installation.

limits: Visible enabled clippings undergo synchronous source extraction on every render; physical latency and memory remain unqualified.
Native highlight-toggle window input, physical touch and display refresh behavior remain unqualified.
Existing glyph advance-box limitations apply; no note text, highlight color/style selection, or cross-page selection gestures.
No independent network interoperability rerun, grayscale firmware build or clean reproducibility pair in this checkpoint.
